visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a brown jumpsuit, black cap, and beard stands in a museum-style industrial hall with large machinery in the background. (2) Close-up on the internal movement of a gold watch; a precision screwdriver is adjusting a tiny screw on a part labeled HORAGE. (3) A vintage mechanical machine with belts is shown, followed by a foot pressing a metal pedal on the floor. (4) Macro view of a sharp blade slowly carving a slot into the head of a rotating screw. (5) Extreme close-up of a thin silver metal rod on a blue surface. (6) Cooling oil sprays onto a rotating metal part inside a machining chamber. (7) An intricate mechanical setup with gears and levers is shown, labeled Thread machining. (8) A black and white archival photo displays a historical factory filled with workers and rows of machines. (9) Return to vintage machinery, specifically a Dual-spindle machine with synchronized gears and belts. (10) The man points to a massive green industrial machine with TORNOS printed on it. (11) A modern, brightly lit factory scene with workers at high-tech stations is shown. (12) Gloved hands rotate a finished luxury mechanical watch to show its movement. (13) The man waves and smiles at the camera to conclude the video.

(2) Soft metallic clicking sounds are heard in the mix as the speaker describes watch parts. (3) A low rhythmic mechanical whirring sound accompanies the visual of the manual pedal. (4) High-pitched screeching and scraping sound effects are synchronized with the blade carving the screw head. (5) A white-noise 'shhh' sound of liquid spray is layered over the vocal track. (6) Consistent rhythmic mechanical ticking SFX occurs, matching the gear movements on screen. (7) A sharp whoosh transition sound marks a significant scene cut. narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Historical Evidence -> Technological Evolution -> Modern Context -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To educate the audience on the intricate history and manufacturing process of watch screws, highlighting the evolution of industrial machinery from manual foot-pedal lathes to dual-spindle integrated systems, while endorsing the heritage of the Laubscher company.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct mention and visual display of the brand's machinery and history as superior suppliers.
